candidate_statement.relation: A typed binary relation R on represented P-elements.
candidate_statement.two_step_return: For represented x,y,z, P(x), P(y), P(z), R(x,y), R(y,z) imply z=x.
candidate_statement.no_self_loop: For represented x in P, not R(x,x).
candidate_statement.semantic_level: Pure first-order/Core-definable relation behavior; no totality, single-valuedness, function, geometry, projective, quaternionic, topology, or field semantics.

declared_scope.generic: Any represented carrier and typed binary relation satisfying two-step return and no-self-loop.

motivating_evidence: The prior total-self-map candidate passed source-neutral G6 but failed W G7 only on totality and single-valuedness.
W-SSC-097-O06 directly supplies the two-step-return law.
W-SSC-097-O04 directly supplies no projective fixed points.
prohibited_evidence: historical W closure packets as authority
predicted_consequences: A symmetric two-point relation aRb,bRa passes.
A two-step chain aRb,bRc with c!=a fails.
An empty relation passes; the candidate does not assert existence or totality.
A one-way edge aRb with no outgoing edge from b passes; the candidate does not assert symmetry, totality, or functionhood.
Multivalued relations are permitted only insofar as every realized two-step path returns to its start and no self-loop exists.
known_alternatives: Reopen source granularity if exact source application incidence cannot be represented even relationally.
A stronger function schema if later source evidence explicitly supplies totality/single-valuedness.
positive_controls: one-way edge with no two-step continuation
negative_adversarial_controls: extra continuation from partner that fails return
falsifiers: Any need for totality or single-valuedness to state the candidate.
Any positive nonclaim model rejected because function semantics leaked in.
Any negative two-step-return or self-loop control accepted.
Failure of W G7 to match O06/O04 even after removing the unsupported function obligations.
adaptive_evidence: The candidate is a direct revision after W_G7_FIXED_POINT_FREE_INVOLUTION_INSTANTIATION_0_1 falsified only totality/single-valuedness.
coverage_limits: No claim about existence, totality, uniqueness, symmetry, projective geometry, or vector-level structure.
